_meta.description: Binary interaction data: NRTL parameters, liquid miscibility flags and solid solubility data.
_meta.nrtl_form: tau_ij = a_ij + b_ij/T + e_ij ln(T) + f_ij T ;  G_ij = exp(-alpha_ij tau_ij) ;  alpha_ij = c_ij + d_ij (T - 273.15 K)  (Aspen Plus NRTL form; T in K)
_meta.warning: All NRTL sets below were regressed to VLE data. VLE-fitted parameters reproduce G^E but usually NOT its temperature derivatives (H^E, Cp^E). Use cp_engine.models.nrtl.fit_nrtl_to_excess() to refit to H^E / Cp^E data when available.
